scope: Default DWG HATCH patterned-fill overall angle and definition-line angles only: public/DXF groups 52/53 remain degrees; HATCH DWG BD fields are converted to/from radians. Solid HATCH and gradient/boundary angle fields retain their existing semantics. MPOLYGON's DWG parser, encoder and shared validation behavior remain unchanged pending independent evidence.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.4.75 lists the HATCH overall angle BD (DXF 52) and each definition-line angle BD (DXF 53); the listed fields do not explicitly state their units. ODA-produced AC1021 plus LibreDWG and ODA DXF observations independently establish radians for the selected DWG and degrees for its DXF. Existing libdxfrw and LibreCAD DXF interfaces preserve the two fields in degrees.
physical_source: Scratch ezdxf 1.4.5 authored an AC1027 DXF with one ANSI31 patterned HATCH, 30-degree overall angle, one 75-degree pattern line, and a four-corner closed polyline boundary. `author-source.py OUTPUT` reproduces this geometry, though DXF document metadata can differ. ODA File Converter 27.1.0 produced an AC1021 DWG; GNU LibreDWG 0.14 decodes overall=0.5235987755983 rad and line=1.30899693899575 rad. ODA's AC1027 DXF return reports 30 and 75 degrees and the same boundary. Original native callback exposed 0.5235987755983 and 1.30899693899575; corrected callback exposes 29.999999999999996 and 75. The ODA lineage is the recorded scratch invocation, not authenticated by the hashes alone.
generated_output: Scratch author.cpp uses existing material/plotstyle graph opt-ins and authors the same model-space HATCH geometry. Existing writer emits 30 and 75 radians, and ODA DXF returns 1718.87338539247 and 4297.183463481174 degrees. Corrected writer emits pi/6 and 75*pi/180 radians; ODA DXF returns 30 and 75 degrees. Independent LibreDWG and ezdxf verifier checks hashes, angles, flags and exact boundary vertices; the final post-facade-guard build reproduces the corrected DWG byte-for-byte.
mpolygon_limit: A separate ezdxf-authored MPOLYGON with the same pattern converts through ODA, but ODA returns its overall DXF angle as 0 rather than the authored 30 while the line remains 75; LibreDWG reports inconsistent leading fields and the existing native reader emits no typed callback. This is not producer evidence for changing MPOLYGON. Its old and corrected-build encoded frames compare byte-for-byte for six revisions.
validation: test.cpp passes AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 native HATCH encode/readback with 30/75, exact structural AC1021 pattern BDs plus following counts, HATCH and MPOLYGON direct controls, ARC/ELLIPSE boundary field preservation, parser truncation/reset/retry, corrupted 1e308-radian source at both pattern angle positions with reset/retry, direct partial-bit buffer atomic refusal of nonfinite and zero/subnormal converted angles, and corrected retries. It exercises ignored-return destination sentinel and same-writer retry through writeHatch and writePoint; derived custom HATCH codec keeps its earlier skip behavior. `compare.cpp` gives byte-identical pre/post streams for MPOLYGON patterned, solid HATCH and gradient HATCH with ARC/ELLIPSE boundaries for all six revisions. A previous library fails the new exact-radian test. Final output was relinked against the final scratch library and reproduces the ODA-tested DWG hash.
limits: Changing the DWG HATCH callback fields from raw radians to degrees corrects their long-standing DXF API contract; DWG consumers that compensated for the old radians must remove that workaround. Only selected patterned HATCH fields and boundary are externally qualified; not full rendering, arbitrary source versions, native application, gradient/MPOLYGON, or whole-file interoperability. New rejection latches only exact built-in HATCH; a derived subclass that inherits its guarded codec and ignores false retains legacy skip behavior. Nonzero degree values producing zero/subnormal radians conservatively refuse. Solid HATCH's unused pattern angles are unchanged.

commands.source: ODAFileConverter /private/tmp/hatch-angle/in /private/tmp/hatch-angle/dwg ACAD2007 DWG 0 1 '*.dxf'; ODAFileConverter /private/tmp/hatch-angle/dwg /private/tmp/hatch-angle/out ACAD2013 DXF 0 1 '*.dwg'
commands.audit: For each audit_pairs entry, run python -O tools/audit_dwg_hatch_pattern_angles.py --dwg <dwg> --dwg-sha256 <dwg_sha256> --dxf <dxf> --dxf-sha256 <dxf_sha256> --overall <overall> --line <line> --dwgread /opt/homebrew/bin/dwgread after verifying independent_reader.sha256.
